facts.text: Graduates of the Bachelor of Science in Aeronautics degree benefit from FAA Part 141 approval that reduces the required flight hours for an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate from 1,500 down to 1,000 hours.

sources.title: Bachelor of Science in Aeronautics - Aviation Degrees | CAU
sources.quote: Eligible degree students receive crucial time-saving benefits, including qualifying for a R-ATP with only 1,000 flight hours
